title: 농촌계획 2025년 제31권 1호
headline: 서울대학교 연구진이 2편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘Forecasting Model’, ‘Grid Data’, ‘Population Projection’, ‘Rural Migration Rate’, ‘Hometown Love Donation’.

papers.title: 농촌다움 개념에 기반한 지역관광 활용 연구 - 고창 학원농장을 사례로 -
papers.title_en: A Study on the Utilization of Local Tourism based on the Concept of New Ruralism Focusing on the Case of Hakwon Farm in Go-chang County

summary.result: As a result, a series of processes related to local tourism were found to have played a role in strengthening the conservation activities of the Hakwon farm.
summary.background: The purpose of this study is to present a method for applying the 4Cs of New ruralism: Conservation, Cultivation, Community, and Creativity to the establishment of rural spatial planning principles for rural regeneration, while examining the role and effect of local tourism and suggesting utilization methods.
summary.method: The research data was organized using the data analysis method of grounded theory research, and the process of formation and conservation of local assets, local tourism utilization of local assets, and the relationship between rural regeneration were analyzed based on the concept of New ruralism in the case of the Hakwon farm, and implications that can be helpful for future research on rural spatial planning principles and policy development for rural regeneration were presented.

papers.title: 헬스케어 식물 생산단지 잠재이용자의 선호 요소 이해 - Kano 모형과 고객만족계수를 활용하여 -
papers.title_en: Understanding the Preferences of Potential users in Healthcare Plant Production Complex - Application of the Kano Model and Timko's Customer Satisfaction Coefficient -

summary.result: Our findings indicate that the creation of a complex facility combining practical accessibility factors, such as 'convenience in using parking facilities' with diverse experiential elements, such as 'plant cultivation experience', can positively impact visitation demand and user satisfaction.
summary.background: Our study aims to identify the attributes that plan production and distribution centers need to develop to offer a more diverse experiential value, considering the increasing preference and demand for plant cultivation activities in contemporary society.
summary.method: Utilizing the Kano model and Timko's customer satisfaction coefficient, we identified components that significantly influence potential user satisfaction.

papers.title: 이촌율 방정식을 활용한 농촌 소지역 격자인구 전망
papers.title_en: Projection of Grid Population in Rural Micro-Areas Using the Rural Migration Rate Equation

summary.result: A limitation of this study is that it does not fully incorporate sociological factors affecting rural areas, requiring further research to address this issue.
summary.background: Grid data was extracted, and a rural migration model was developed, which was then incorporated into the Cohort Component Method (CCM) to project populations by gender and age group.
summary.method: In the case of Osu-myeon, Imsil-gun, the population is projected to decline from 3,274 in 2000 to 1,222 in 2040, representing an average annual decrease of 2.4%.

papers.title: 농촌공간정비사업 대상지 우선순위 및 정비시설 영향 평가 방안 - 강원도 양양군을 대상으로 -
papers.title_en: Priority Evaluation for Target Area Selection and Impact Assessment Methods of Facilities Management for Rural Space Improvement Projects - Focusing on Yangyang-gun of Gangwon-do -

summary.result: Quantitative indices (landscape indices) using Fragstats were selected to assess the clustering of residential areas (AI), the separation distance from facilities requiring maintenance (ENN, CONTAG), and urban sprawl (SHDI).
summary.background: By establishing scenarios based on the proximity of residential areas to facilities requiring maintenance, we evaluate the impact of these projects.
summary.method: A spatial analysis was performed in Uam-ri, Sonyang-myeon, Yangyang County, considering the distribution of residential areas and facilities requiring maintenance (barns).

papers.title: 농업용 용수로의 관개기 온실가스 배출특성 분석 - 백곡저수지 사례로 -
papers.title_en: Analysis of Greenhouse Gas Emission during Irrigation Periods in Agriculture Irrigation Canals - Case of Baekgok Reservoir -

summary.result: Based on the measurement results from 8 AM to 4 PM, the representative emission time for the concrete canal (ICC) was calculated as 8 AM, while the soil canal (ICS) showed similar results to the average at 10 AM.
summary.background: The purpose of this study was to analyze the greenhouse gas emission characteristics during the irrigation period of the Baegok Reservoir irrigation canals, both concrete and soil, by measuring emissions from May to September.
summary.method: To analyze the greenhouse gases in the irrigation canals, CH 4 and CO 2 were measured using a closed floating chamber.

papers.title: 농촌 시설의 유니버설디자인 적용 실태 및 개선 방향 연구 - 순창군 풍산면 30개소 커뮤니티시설을 중심으로 -
papers.title_en: A Study on the Application Status of Universal Design in Rural Facilities - Focusing on 30 Community Facilities in Pungsan-myeon, Sunchang-gun -

summary.result: Policy and legal gaps further hinder widespread adoption, as current regulations do not adequately mandate accessibility improvements for small rural facilities.
summary.background: Rural community facilities are essential for social interaction and welfare services, particularly for aging populations.
summary.method: The implementation of universal design in rural community facilities faces structural, regulatory, and financial limitations.

papers.title: '로코노미'식품, 고향사랑기부제 활성화의 수단이 될 수 있을까?
papers.title_en: Do 'Loconomy' Foods Promote the Hometown Love Donation System?

summary.result: Results indicate a positive correlation: consumers who purchase loconomy food demonstrate a positive attitude towards donating through the Hometown Love Donation System.
summary.background: Loconomy food, a recent trend in the food industry, combines "local" and "economy," aiming to maximize regional value and develop the local or agricultural economy by leveraging regional specialties and unique cultural assets.
summary.method: Employing a recursive bivariate probit model to address potential endogeneity, the study examines the impact of loconomy food purchases on participation in the Hometown Love Donation System, accounting for the interrelationship between these two activities.
